venture: DOJ administrative claims and Trump v. IRS settlement
basis: Trump's roughly $230M FTCA claims were withdrawn in the 18 May 2026 IRS settlement, which gave Trump an apology and no payment, per DOJ and press reports.
notes: The $1.776B anti-weaponization fund was for others, not Trump. A judge found the suit collusive in July 2026, and DOJ said the fund is not proceeding; an appeal is pending. Reported audit protections are single-source and have no dollar value here.
